title.narrative: UNICEF contributed to strengthening the resilience of the education system by generating stronger political will to promote safe, resilient learning environments, culminating in a high-level pledge to end violence in schools at the Global Conference on Ending Violence against Children; the validation of a national initiative on positive discipline; and the national rollout of school safety guidelines. Other key results include the new curriculum content on digital safety and well-being that promotes 21st-Century skills for adolescents and the innovative modelling of using sport as a platform to foster social cohesion and challenge harmful gender norms.
